notes.title: Soundtrack now Available for free!
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Thanks for trying out my game! I've noticed some people asking about the soundtrack, so I decided to upload it all to YouTube. You can listen to it here:

https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBNU4GQMjcay9nKyCdhZxL8LEswnQw3Rd

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39218594/5f086cb96c9699a646c8b71a20a954906dbce8fc.png[/img]

There is also a google drive link with the full OST as .WAV files. You are free to use the music for background music or whatever, as long as you credit me. Do not sell it as your own. Thanks a bunch!

-Joseph

notes.title: Checkpoints are Here: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Thank you all for trying out my game. It has become apparent that checkpoints are needed. As a solo developer making games for myself, it is hard sometimes to recognize when I've made an obvious omission, so I've listened to the feedback and added checkpoints.

Another change I've made is how the timer works. Now the time continues even if you die, but you can restart completely with a fresh timer by restarting the level from the pause menu.

The game will still be hard and frustrating even with checkpoints, but I hope more of you will stick it out until the end with their addition.

Thanks a bunch!

-Joe
